app.name: Value Wallet
history.title: Earlier versions
withdraw.confirm: Withdraw this? It disappears from the lists; its history stays in your wallet.
erase.confirm: Erase this and all its versions for good? Only an empty mark with the date stays. This cannot be undone.
err.notJson: This file is not a wallet file
err.tooBig: The file is larger than 20 MB
start.lead: Your own timeline of value: who did what with what or whom, what was promised, what it gave and cost you, and how much it moved your goals.
start.f1: It stays on this device, encrypted with your passphrase. Nothing is sent anywhere unless you send it.
start.f2: Your scale, your words. There are no scores of people.
start.f3: If you forget the passphrase, nobody can open the wallet. Keep an exported copy.
unlock.title: Open {name}
unlock.wrong: This passphrase does not open the wallet
create.title: Create a wallet
create.label: Your name in this wallet
create.labelHint: It goes on your card when you share it.
create.passHint: At least 4 words or 14 characters. A sentence you will remember works best.
create.ack: I understand: if I forget the passphrase, nobody can open this wallet, and nobody can recover it.
create.ackNeeded: Please confirm that you understand this
create.weak: Too short: use at least 4 words or 14 characters
import.bad: This is not a wallet file of a known version
import.chain: The file has {n} damaged places; everything readable is kept
import.saved: The wallet is now on this device
import.openFirst: Open your wallet first, then open the message
roleQ.affected: Someone did something to me or for me
ev.empty: Nothing yet. Record something that happened today: a hug, a purchase, a walk, a favour.
ev.didHint: In your words: hugged, bought, built, helped, walk on...
ev.due: Time to look back (dates you set yourself)
el.label: What
plan.title: Promise or expectation
plan.hint: The supplier's planned value (a maker, a builder, a service) or your own expectation. It is shown, and counts in your figures only as much as you decide (0 by default).
plan.author: Whose promise
plan.need: Write what was promised or expected
as.title: How was it for me: {ev}
as.retroHint: Looking back becomes available after a realized assessment.
as.noGoals: Add value systems and goals to see how much this moved what matters to you.
as.spentHint: Time, money or effort taken from your goals. Used for efficiency.
as.ownHint: Any number on your own scale.
as.planCountHint: 0 means the promise does not count until you assess it yourself.
as.checkHint: Shown only when you open the wallet. No reminders.
as.reference: Use this as a reference for its value system
or.title: Orientation: {sys}
or.noRefs: No references yet. Mark an assessment as a reference, or add a system from a registry.
or.noGoals: No goals in this system yet.
val.none: Link it to a goal to see how much it moved what matters to you.
val.moved: This moved about {k} of the goal "{goal}", which is about {w} of what matters to you now. So it moved about {v} of what matters to you.
val.harm: This set the goal "{goal}" back by about {k}, and that goal is about {w} of what matters to you now. So it cost about {v} of what matters to you.
val.ref: That is about {x} times the reference "{ref}".
val.refSame: That is about the same as the reference "{ref}".
val.refLess: That is about {x} of the reference "{ref}".
val.top3: It is one of the three most valuable things of the last 30 days.
val.rank: It is number {n} of {of} things you assessed in the last 30 days.
fc.title: Does this fit how you feel?
fc.lessHint: Lower the contribution or check the goal's numbers
fc.moreHint: Raise the contribution or check the goal's numbers
flag.goal-overfilled: Contributions to "{goal}" already add up to more than it needs, but the goal is still open. Maybe it needs more than you wrote, or it is reached.
flag.scale-disagrees: Your own scores and these shares of what matters order your recent things quite differently. One of them may not match how you feel.
flag.top-goal-untouched: Your most important goal "{goal}" got nothing in 90 days while other goals did. Is it still the most important?
sh.title: Share with {name}
sh.noCard: To send to {name} you need their card. Ask them to send their card file or show their QR code and card, then add it on the Contacts tab.
sh.policy: What the recipient does with assessments
sh.publishes.anonymous: May publish them without your data.
sh.publishes.named: May publish them with your name.
sh.publishes.sender-choice: Publishes them only the way you choose.
sh.anon: Send without my address (they will not know who sent it)
sh.delivery: The message is encrypted for the recipient only. For now you deliver it yourself as a file; the institute relay that passes messages without keeping them comes later.
sh.ready: Message saved as a file. Send it to the recipient any way you like.
ct.qrLabel: QR code with my wallet address
ct.myHint: Others scan the QR code or paste the link to add you as a contact. To send you encrypted messages they also need your card file.
ct.scanHint: Point the camera at the wallet's QR code.
ct.noScanner: This browser cannot read QR codes from the camera. Paste the address or link instead.
ct.notCard: This file is not a wallet card
ct.empty: People, organisations, state bodies and devices you have events with appear here.
ct.addressHint: Paste an address or a wallet link. A contact without an address is fine too.
ct.badAddress: This is not a wallet address
cp.name: Name
sys.lead: Value systems are areas of your life or communities you take part in: family, health, city, work. Their weights say how much each matters in your whole life; goals live inside them.
sys.title: Name
sys.W: How much it matters in my life
sys.WHint: Any positive number; only the proportions between systems count.
sys.needW: The weight must be a positive number
sys.noGoals: No goals in this system yet.
goal.title: Goal
goal.NHint: On the same scale; empty means the same as importance.
goal.needS: Importance must be a positive number
goal.needN: Need must be a positive number
fact.lead: Anything that matters for your goals and how you value things. Facts change, and that is normal; revise them when you see more clearly.
fact.exploringLong: I am still figuring this out
reg.title: Registry of {name}
reg.hint: Objects and events this organisation published. Choose one to add it to your timeline; its promise comes with it.
reg.bad: This file is not a registry
reg.badSig: The registry signature does not verify
reg.sysNote: Added from a public registry; adjust the weight to your life.
an.lead: Counted on this device only, from confirmed events. Value is the share of what matters to you that events moved.
in.noSuggested: Nothing suggested. Devices and agents will be able to suggest events here; nothing reaches your timeline without your yes.
in.publish.anonymous: You may publish it without the sender's data.
in.publish.named: You may publish it with the sender's name.
in.suggestionNote: {n} events were added to the suggestions above.
in.notMessage: This file is not a message
in.dropped: Not added: your settings block such requests
set.requestsHint: Suppliers may ask you to assess something they know you used. Blocked requests are dropped silently; the sender cannot tell.
set.blockSystems: Block requests in these value systems
set.blockContactsHint: You can also block requests from a particular contact on the Contacts tab.
set.planHint: How much a promise counts in your own figures before you assess it yourself.
set.myPolicyHint: Goes on your card. Others see it before they share an assessment with you.
set.stores: I keep assessments others send me
set.storageHint: You can also keep file copies yourself: export the encrypted file and put it on another device or drive.
set.readableWarn: This file will not be encrypted. Anyone who gets it can read everything. Continue?
set.passHint: Records stay as they are; only the key that opens them changes.
set.remove: Remove this wallet from this device
set.removeConfirm: Remove the wallet from this device? Without an exported copy it is gone for good.
type.title: Add a type
type.name: Name
foot.locked: Locked. Your data stays on this device.
foot.unlocked: Open on this device. Locks after 15 minutes without activity.
pv.lead: A provider keeps an encrypted copy of your wallet and lets your other devices sync. It never sees your passphrase or anything readable. You can use several and move between them.
pv.none: No providers yet. The wallet lives only on this device.
pv.aevriHint: The institute keeps only encrypted copies. Its storage service requires an institute account.
pv.ageNeeded: The institute keeps copies for people aged 18 or older
pv.githubHint: Create a private repository, then a fine-grained token with "Contents: read and write" for that repository only. The token is kept inside your encrypted wallet. Note: an erased record stays in the repository history as unreadable ciphertext.
pv.tokenHint: Stored only inside your encrypted wallet.
pv.githubNeed: Fill in owner, repository and token
pv.urlHint: A server that speaks the open Value Wallet provider protocol.
pv.urlNeed: The address must start with https://
pv.addGo: Connect and make the first copy
pv.added: Provider added; the first copy is made
pv.removeConfirm: Delete the copy of this wallet at this provider? Your device keeps its own copy.
pv.recoveryOn: Recovery through this provider is on: it can technically read this wallet.
pv.recoveryOffConfirm: Turn recovery off? Then nobody can help you if you forget the passphrase.
pv.recoveryExplain: If you forget the passphrase, this provider can give you access again after its procedure: an identity check and a waiting time of {days} days, with a notice to your devices ({notify}) so you can stop someone else trying.
pv.canRead: In this mode the provider can technically read your wallet. Without it, a forgotten passphrase means the wallet is lost for good.
pv.recoveryAck: I understand that this provider can technically read my wallet
pv.recoveryEnabled: Recovery through this provider is on
pv.noOffer: This provider does not offer recovery
pv.noticeTitle: Someone asked to recover access to this wallet
pv.notice: A recovery request was filed at {where} on {at}. Access will be released after {ready} if the identity check passes. If this was not you, cancel it now.
rs.title: Restore from a copy
rs.codeHint: Shown in Settings next to each provider on your other device.
rs.token: GitHub token (only for a GitHub copy)
rs.badCode: This is not a restore code
rs.done: The wallet is restored on this device
fg.title: I forgot my passphrase
fg.lead: This works only if you allowed recovery through a provider. The provider checks who you are and waits before it gives access, and your other devices are told about the request.
fg.contact: How the provider can reach you
fg.contactHint: For the identity check, for example an e-mail address or a phone number.
fg.badCode: Use the restore code of a provider that allows recovery
fg.noSlot: This wallet has no recovery through this provider. Without the passphrase it cannot be opened.
fg.filed: Request filed. Access can be released after {ready}, once the check passes.
fg.waiting: Still waiting (not before {ready}, and only after the identity check)
fg.status.cancelled: The request was cancelled from one of the wallet's devices
fg.status.unknown: The provider does not know this request
fg.newLead: Access is back. Choose a new passphrase; the old one will no longer open the wallet.
fg.recovered: Access recovered with a new passphrase
pv.signIn: Sign in to the institute first (top right of the site), then add the provider again.
rl.title: Messages and the relay
rl.lead: The institute relay passes encrypted messages between wallets and keeps nothing: a message waits only until the recipient picks it up, at most 14 days, and nobody but the recipient can read it. Without the relay you hand messages over as files.
rl.use: Send and receive messages through the relay
rl.urlHint: Any relay that speaks the open Value Wallet relay protocol.
rl.policy: This relay keeps a message at most {days} days and logs no content.
rl.publish: Publish my card in the directory
rl.published: Your card is in the directory
rl.publishHint: With your card in the directory, people who scanned your QR code can send you encrypted messages without asking for the card file. Publishing is your choice.
sh.viaRelay: The message is encrypted for the recipient only and goes through the relay, which does not keep it.
rc.title: Confirm together with {name}
rc.lead: Both of you sign the same record of this event. Only digests of what happened go into the record; the words stay between the two of you.
rc.mode: If you ever disagree about it
rc.mode.attest: The arbiter only confirms what was signed and when
rc.mode.opinion: The arbiter may give an expert opinion
rc.mode.binding: We both accept the arbiter's decision
rc.modeHint: The arbiter is the institute unless you set another. A decision binds only if both of you sign this choice.
rc.accepted: Confirmed; the event is on your timeline
cs.title: Ask the arbiter about this event
cs.lead: You show the arbiter the signed record of this event. Only the digests are in it; add in your own words what happened and what you ask for.
cs.request.attest: Confirm what was signed and when
cs.request.decision: A decision (only if you both agreed it binds)
cs.sent: Sent. Check here for the answer; the arbiter rules say how long it takes.
cs.noBinding: A decision is possible only if both of you chose a binding arbiter when you confirmed the event. Ask for an opinion instead.
reg.openHint: A registry is a signed list of works, objects or events an organisation offers. The institute registry lists its research works; after you read or apply one, you can tell the institute what it gave you.
link.contact: Open or create your wallet to add {name} to your contacts.
link.registry: Open or create your wallet to assess a work from the registry at {host}.
reg.source: Published at {host}, signed by its owner.
vet.hint: VET lets you place what you received and what it cost you on your own scales. Its numbers stay next to your assessment; they do not change the value above.
vet.useOwn: Use the VET result as my own score
vet.title: Estimate in VET
vet.unsupported: This VET cannot estimate events from the wallet yet.
vet.timeout: VET did not answer. Close and try again later.
vet.in: What it cost me to receive
br.title: Value Stream Schemas (VSS)
br.lead: When a VSS schema opens your wallet to record transfers along a flow, it sees only what you allow here. Your assessments stay in the wallet.
br.share.fact: That a transfer happened, its date and my role
br.share.value: Also the value and cost I assessed
ai.title: Materials of the institute on your timeline
ai.lead: Adds every research work, news item and learning material of the Aeilus Value Research Institute (ÆVRI) to your timeline, once. Running it again adds only what is new.
ai.mine: Also bring my own reactions from my ÆVRI account as assessments
ai.privacy: The site sends only your own reactions, and only to this page in your browser. They are kept in your encrypted wallet; nothing goes back.
ai.offSite: Your reactions can be brought in only from the wallet at aeilus.institute.
ai.signIn: Sign in to aeilus.institute first, then run it again.
q.title: One by one
cal.left: Reactions to calibrate by your goals: {n}
an.rxNone: No reactions yet in this period.
an.rxQueue: Assess the other {n} one by one
bio.title: Unlock with this device
bio.lead: Open the wallet on this device with your fingerprint, face or device PIN instead of the passphrase. The passphrase still works and stays the key for other devices.
bio.offDone: Unlock with this device is off
bio.offHint: The passkey stays in your device settings; you can delete it there.
bio.onDone: Unlock with this device is on
bio.unsupported: This browser cannot give the wallet a key from your biometrics, so the wallet opens with the passphrase.
bio.noPrf: This browser or device does not give a key from biometrics (PRF). The wallet keeps opening with the passphrase.
bio.failed: The device did not confirm. Try again or use the passphrase.
life.title: My life
life.empty: Spheres appear as you add events or open a registry.
life.noEvents: No events in this sphere yet.
life.noGoals: No goals in this sphere yet. Value by goals appears once you add them; reactions will be calibrated.
life.mapLabel: Exchanges of this sphere: me on the left, sides on the right
life.mapHint: Green: I receive. Blue: I give. Numbers are events. Tap a side to open it.
life.groupHint: Spheres of one kind sit together: family where I grew up and my family now are both in Family.
rf.title: Refine this assessment
rf.noReaction: No reaction yet. You can assess by comparison or by goals without one.
rf.compareHint: More or less than something you remember
rf.goalsHint: Which goal it moved and by how much
rf.goalsNone: Add a goal first; it takes a minute
rf.costHint: Time, money, other goals; all fields
cmp.title: Compare
cmp.q: Was the effect a benefit or a harm?
cmp.unclear: Then keep the reaction; you can compare later.
cmp.vs: Compared with this event, the benefit was:
cmp.vsHarm: Compared with this event, the harm was:
cmp.refRel: no value by goals yet; the comparison stays relative
cmp.hint: Coarse is honest: half, same, twice. The goal assessment, when you make it, is the one used in totals.
cmp.none: There is no assessed event with a benefit to compare with yet. Assess this one by goals, or compare later.
cmp.noneHarm: There is no assessed event with a harm to compare with yet.
gq.title: Assess by goals
gq.how: How much did this event contribute?
gq.hint: Only this event, not the whole progress so far.
vss.lead: Link a value stream schema to this sphere. The map then shows the schema from your place in it, with the events you recorded on its flows.
vss.signIn: Sign in to aeilus.institute to see your schemas.
vss.noneMine: You have no saved schemas yet.
vss.onlySite: Your schemas can be listed only in the wallet at aeilus.institute.
vss.badLink: This is not a link to a VSS schema.
vss.notVss: This file is not a VSS schema.
vss.matchSides: Match other nodes to your contacts
vss.missing: The schema copy is missing; link it again.
vss.noContact: {name} is not matched to a contact yet
vss.mapHint: Solid: flows with your events (number). Dashed: expected flows without events yet.
vss.rest: {n} more flows of the schema do not involve you.
vss.unlinkQ: Unlink this schema from the sphere? Events stay.
start.oldBrowser: This browser cannot make the wallet's signatures (Ed25519). Update Chrome (version 137 or newer), Safari 17 or Firefox 129, then open the wallet again.
